use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

claims.content: C2 JU defines reference points and geometric areas, including AOPs, and sets their force-tell status in the J3.0 Reference Point message.

scope_contract.goal_statement: C2 JU defines reference points and geometric areas, with force-tell status set as needed and AOPs expressed as geometric areas.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The C2 JU selects a reference point, line, or geometric area; creates or updates its J3.0 Reference Point message; and sets the FT IND to initiate the desired force-tell alert. If the geometric area is an AOP, it is defined using the available source data.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The C2 JU begins a definition action for a reference point, line, or geometric area.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The J3.0 Reference Point message contains the defined reference point or geometric area with the requested FT IND, and AOP content if applicable.
in_scope_actions: Set FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message to initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area
Define/report an Area of Probability (AOP) as a geometric area based on organic data, LOB exchange, EW fix analysis, or combination
excluded_adjacent_actions: Force-tell alert message dissemination or downstream alert processing
Administrative handling of the J3.0 message outside the definition action
variant_dimensions: Reference point vs line vs geometric area
AOP source data: organic data, LOB exchange, EW fix data, or combination
